title.narrative: Psychosocial, medical, legal and other types of assistance for victims provided by IFS EMMAUS specialist staff

description.narrative: Recovery and reintegration services to persons at risk, the presumed, and identified THB victims, in line with Minimum Standards for the provision of aid to THB victims

comment.narrative: By 2020 Direct assistance and shelter were provided by the IFS EMMAUS to over 289 victims of THB Assistance was provided for 145 children at risk per day in Daily Centres.Baseline value is set to 0 to measure assistance provided by the Action.

In year 1 the Action enabled direct shelter support to 30 THB victims who received psychosocial support medical services free legal advice and services supporting them in reintegration exercising social welfare rights aid with education and upbringing etc.Through the work of IFSEMMAUS Daily Centres in Velika Kladua and Tuzla for 610 foreign children en route IFSEMMAUS provided aid in form of a meal and information on risks of THB reporting and aid possibilities in THB suspicious situations. Information was provided in form of posters in Pashto Arabic Farsi Urdu English and local languages. In IFSEMMAUS Reception Centre for en route children 237 unaccompanied minors in risk of trafficking received sheltering and emergency aid as well as information on THB risks reporting and aid possibilities in THB suspicious situations.Children en route in Bosnia and Herzegovina are one of the most vulnerable categories of persons in risk of being trafficked and in the context of antitrafficking actions in BiH some aid and assistance had to be offered to them as well.
